jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Multiverse Keys
jokes.joke: I’m so forgetful I’d be useless in a parallel universe. I’d finally meet alternate me and say, “Great—one of us must remember where I left my keys.” He’d pat his pockets and go, “Wait… I came here to ask you.” That’s when I’d realize the multiverse isn’t infinite possibilities. It’s just me losing the same keys in more dimensions.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: The Movers
jokes.joke: I hired removalists to move house, and I watched two grown men carry my couch to the truck, then carry it back inside, then back to the truck. I said, 'Guys, what's going on?' One of them goes, 'Sorry mate, we forgot if this one's already loaded.' I said, 'How many trips has it done?' He goes, 'Honestly? Could be its first day. Could be retired.' I've seen goldfish with better logistics.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: The Movers
seedTermsUsed: A fear or phobia rearing its head
jokes.joke: I hired professional movers last week, mostly because I have a crippling phobia of eye contact with my friends. If you pay two guys named Vlad three hundred dollars, you don't have to pretend you're going to help carry the sleeper sofa. You can just stand in the driveway holding a single framed photo of your dog like an evacuee.

jokes.label: Joke D

jokes.title: Forgetful Mover
jokes.joke: I hired a removalist last week. Nicest guy. Super careful with the boxes. He packed my whole apartment, labeled everything, loaded the truck, drove off... and texted me an hour later from his own driveway: 'Hey, found a bunch of random furniture in my truck. You want any of it before I unpack?'

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Cosmic Mix‑Up
jokes.joke: I’m so forgetful I swear I slipped into a parallel universe last week. I walked into my kitchen and thought, “Who moved the toaster?” Then I realized it was me… yesterday… in this universe. At this point I’m not losing my mind, I’m just multiverse‑bad at remembering where I put it.
